speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Tetanus (via maternal ingestion of *Clostridium tetani* spores in contaminated ice cream)

The patient is at 30 weeks gestation and reports eating ice cream three days before symptom onset. While the classic signs of tetanus (lockjaw, trismus, rigidity) are not yet described, the sudden onset of fever and severe systemic illness in this specific context warrants immediate confirmation of maternal tetanus status and neonatal risk.
